plan.summary:
This change makes `joinPath` trim each path segment before it drops empty segments and joins them with `/`. A segment that has only whitespace is now removed.

- `src/paths.ts`: adds `part.trim()` before `filter(Boolean)`.
- `tests/paths.test.ts`: tests that `[' a ', 'b', '  ']` gives `'a/b'`.
- `package.json`: adds the new test file to the `test` script.
plan.riskRationale: The change is small and local. It affects one pure helper and has a direct test. Callers that rely on whitespace in segments would see a different result.
plan.storyArc: The fix trims names in `joinPath`. A new test shows the behavior, including the removal of whitespace-only segments. The test script change makes the test run with the other tests.

noise.reason: It only registers the new test file in the test script.

topics.title: Trim path segments before joining
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `joinPath` handle whitespace in segments after this change? Connect the `map(trim)` before `filter(Boolean)` to the test case that has padded and whitespace-only segments.
